verdict.rationale: SumUp docs explicitly describe in-person card readers (Solo/Go) supporting chip and contactless via Cloud API and Reader SDKs, plus Tap to Pay for contactless mobile-wallet payments directly on a phone. Mobile-wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) support at physical readers is implied by contactless/Tap to Pay capability but not separately itemized. Missing for 10: explicit vendor confirmation naming Apple Pay/Google Pay support at readers, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
